latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "company-values" skill to help define minimalist business values and culture.
- Offers structured guidance based on Sahil Lavingia’s minimalist entrepreneurship principles.
- Provides example values from Gumroad as inspiration.
- Includes prompts for self-reflection to create unique company values.
- Covers best practices for operationalizing values and building remote-first cultures.
- Helps users draft 3–5 company values with descriptions, stories, hiring, and work implications, plus anti-patterns.
